description: How a release can reach a unit. A release lists the routes it may use; an installer ignores routes it doesn't know. Add a route here before any release uses it.

routes.meaning: Bluetooth Low Energy, from a host to the unit.
A USB connection from a host to the unit, including USB serial.
A serial link from a host to the unit other than USB, including Bluetooth SPP.
An IP network: HTTP, WebSocket or similar, from a host or a server.
Through a parent device that receives the release and installs it on the unit, for example a controller updating the buttons attached to it.
